structure.unit: Personal Representatives and Administration of Estates

law.catch_line: Distribution to persons standing in loco parentis to certain beneficiaries
law.text: Notwithstanding any provision of law to the contrary, a distribution to a person standing in loco parentis to an incapacitated person or an infant pursuant to authorization under subdivision B 17 of § 64.2-105 or a comparable provision in a will or trust instrument may be approved by the commissioner of accounts without regard to the amount or value of the fund or property.
